title: 焊接与切割设备安全
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/128_焊接与切割设备安全.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/128_焊接与切割设备安全/src.py

points.K1: 焊接切割的危害：弧光、火花、烟尘、触电
points.S1: 焊工持证上岗，动火先审批、有人监护
points.K2: 新到、调来的焊机，逐项检查合格才用
points.K3: 电源开关、外壳绝缘、调节刻度要完好
points.K4: 工业插头、电工接线、漏电保护、外壳接地
points.K5: 焊接电缆、接头、焊钳和接地夹完好
points.K6: 回线就近接在工件上，不借管道
points.K7: 暂停离开先断电，焊钳不乱放
points.K8: 弧光伤眼伤皮肤：面罩、屏挡、旁人别看
points.K9: 焊接烟尘：先排风，再戴防尘口罩
points.K10: 全套焊接防护用品，一样不少
points.K11: 气焊气割：装回火防止器
points.K12: 气瓶用前检查，检漏不用明火

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在焊接防护帘旁，焊机已关机
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a closed orange welding curtain next to a switched off welding machine, smiling at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课：焊接与切割设备安全。

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a welding helmet with a dark lens.
shots.narration: 强光、火花、烟尘和电，一样都不能大意。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰推来一台焊机，电缆破皮
shots.prompt_en: The young male student wheels in a welding machine whose cable has a damaged section, a cardboard box nearby.
shots.narration: 阿杰想自己焊个铁架子。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 他把接地夹夹在水管上，没戴面罩
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a ground clamp attached to a water pipe far from the workpiece and a person without a helmet, question marks. No text.
shots.narration: 接地夹夹在水管上，面罩也没戴。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator stops him and holds up a blank certificate card.
shots.narration: 王老师：你有焊工证吗？先停下！

shots.section_title: 焊接切割的危害：弧光、火花、烟尘、触电
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: bright light rays from a welding point reaching an eye outline and bare skin, warning triangle. No text.
shots.narration: 弧光很强，伤眼睛，也灼伤皮肤。
overlay: 焊接切割的危害：弧光、火花、烟尘、触电

shots.section_title: 焊接切割的危害：弧光、火花、烟尘、触电
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: sparks flying from a welding point onto a cardboard box that starts to smoke, warning triangle. No text.
shots.narration: 火花飞溅，会引燃周围物品。

shots.section_title: 焊接切割的危害：弧光、火花、烟尘、触电
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fume cloud rising from a weld and entering the lungs of a person outline, warning triangle. No text.
shots.narration: 烟尘有毒，吸进去伤肺。

shots.section_title: 焊接切割的危害：弧光、火花、烟尘、触电
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a damaged welding cable and an electrode holder with a lightning bolt toward a hand. No text.
shots.narration: 焊机带电，还有触电危险。

shots.section_title: 焊接切割的危害：弧光、火花、烟尘、触电
shots.scene: 热工件烫伤，气焊还有回火爆炸
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a glowing hot workpiece and a gas torch with a flame travelling back along the hose, warning triangles. No text.
shots.narration: 热工件烫手，气焊还怕回火。

shots.section_title: 焊工持证上岗，动火先审批、有人监护
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blank special operation certificate card beside a welding helmet and a training test sheet with a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 焊接与热切割是特种作业，持证上岗。
overlay: 焊工持证上岗，动火先审批、有人监护

shots.section_title: 焊工持证上岗，动火先审批、有人监护
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a student without a certificate holding an electrode holder, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 没有证，学生不能自己焊。

shots.section_title: 焊工持证上岗，动火先审批、有人监护
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blank hot work permit form with signature lines and a clipboard. No text.
shots.narration: 实验楼里焊割，先办动火审批。

shots.section_title: 焊工持证上岗，动火先审批、有人监护
shots.scene: 清走可燃物，配灭火器，监护人在场
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cleared work area, a fire extinguisher ready and a fire watch person standing nearby. No text.
shots.narration: 清走可燃物，配灭火器，有人监护。

shots.section_title: 焊工持证上岗，动火先审批、有人监护
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fire watch person checking corners and gaps with a flashlight after welding, a clock icon. No text.
shots.narration: 焊完留守检查，确认没有火星。

shots.section_title: 新到、调来的焊机，逐项检查合格才用
shots.scene: 新到的焊机和调来的旧焊机
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a new welding machine in a box and an older machine on a cart arriving at a workshop. No text.
shots.narration: 新到的、调来的焊机，先检查。
overlay: 新到、调来的焊机，逐项检查合格才用

shots.section_title: 新到、调来的焊机，逐项检查合格才用
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a welding machine inspection checklist with blank rows being ticked one by one. No text.
shots.narration: 照清单逐项核对，一个不漏。

shots.section_title: 新到、调来的焊机，逐项检查合格才用
shots.scene: 焊机有遮棚，小车车轮完好
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a welding machine under a protective cover on a cart with sound wheels, a broken wheel crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 焊机有遮棚，小车轮子要完好。

shots.section_title: 新到、调来的焊机，逐项检查合格才用
shots.scene: 全部合格贴标签投入使用
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a welding machine receiving a blank inspection label with a tick, a failed machine tagged out of service. No text.
shots.narration: 全部合格才用，不合格挂牌停用。

shots.section_title: 电源开关、外壳绝缘、调节刻度要完好
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a welding machine with its power switch highlighted by an arrow. No text.
shots.narration: 要有电源开关，出事能马上断电。
overlay: 电源开关、外壳绝缘、调节刻度要完好

shots.section_title: 电源开关、外壳绝缘、调节刻度要完好
shots.scene: 开关松脱、外壳破裂打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a loose broken switch and a cracked machine housing, both crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 开关完好灵活，外壳不能破裂。

shots.section_title: 电源开关、外壳绝缘、调节刻度要完好
shots.scene: 盖板装齐，带电部件不外露
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a welding machine with all side panels fitted, a machine with a missing panel showing internal parts crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 盖板装齐，带电部件绝不外露。

shots.section_title: 电源开关、外壳绝缘、调节刻度要完好
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a current adjustment knob with a clear dial without numbers, a worn unreadable dial crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 调节器要有清楚的刻度。

shots.section_title: 工业插头、电工接线、漏电保护、外壳接地
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an industrial plug and socket connected to a welding machine, bare wires pushed into a socket crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 电源用工业插头插座，不用裸线头。
overlay: 工业插头、电工接线、漏电保护、外壳接地

shots.section_title: 工业插头、电工接线、漏电保护、外壳接地
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an electrician with a blank certificate badge connecting the welding machine power supply. No text.
shots.narration: 电源接线由持证电工来做。

shots.section_title: 工业插头、电工接线、漏电保护、外壳接地
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a residual current device in the supply line of the welding machine with a test button. No text.
shots.narration: 电源装漏电保护，一漏电就断开。

shots.section_title: 工业插头、电工接线、漏电保护、外壳接地
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the metal housing of a welding machine connected to a protective earth symbol. No text.
shots.narration: 焊机外壳，按规定可靠接地。

shots.section_title: 工业插头、电工接线、漏电保护、外壳接地
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person welding while standing in water on a wet floor, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 地面潮湿积水，不焊接。

shots.section_title: 焊接电缆、接头、焊钳和接地夹完好
shots.scene: 【实拍】从头到尾捋查焊接电缆绝缘（焊机断电）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: gloved hands running along a welding cable from the machine end, checking the insulation for cuts.
shots.narration: 焊接电缆从头到尾捋一遍。
overlay: 焊接电缆、接头、焊钳和接地夹完好

shots.section_title: 焊接电缆、接头、焊钳和接地夹完好
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a welding cable with damaged insulation and bare copper showing, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 绝缘破损、露铜的，必须换掉。

shots.section_title: 焊接电缆、接头、焊钳和接地夹完好
shots.scene: 【实拍】电缆端头的接线鼻压接拧紧（断电）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a crimped cable lug bolted tightly to the output terminal of a switched off welding machine.
shots.narration: 接焊机要用接线鼻，压牢拧紧。

shots.section_title: 焊接电缆、接头、焊钳和接地夹完好
shots.scene: 铜丝直接缠绕，发热打火，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: bare copper strands twisted around a terminal, glowing hot with small sparks, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 铜丝直接缠上，会发热打火。

shots.section_title: 焊接电缆、接头、焊钳和接地夹完好
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an intact electrode holder and ground clamp with ticks, a cracked holder and a bent clamp crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 焊钳外壳缺损、夹口变形，要换。

shots.section_title: 焊接电缆、接头、焊钳和接地夹完好
shots.scene: 电缆架离地面，不与电源线缠绕
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a welding cable hung on hooks above the floor, separate from a power cord, a cable in water under a cart wheel crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 电缆架离地面，不泡水、不交叠。

shots.section_title: 回线就近接在工件上，不借管道
shots.scene: 【实拍】接地夹就近夹牢在工件上（断电）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a hand fixing a ground clamp firmly onto the metal workpiece right next to the weld area.
shots.narration: 回线接在离工件最近的地方。
overlay: 回线就近接在工件上，不借管道

shots.section_title: 回线就近接在工件上，不借管道
shots.scene: 接地夹夹在远处水管上，电流乱走
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a ground clamp on a distant water pipe with current arrows wandering through pipes and building steel, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 夹在远处，电流会乱走。

shots.section_title: 回线就近接在工件上，不借管道
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a pipe joint glowing and sparking far from the weld, a fire icon. No text.
shots.narration: 会意外打火、发热，甚至起火。

shots.section_title: 回线就近接在工件上，不借管道
shots.scene: 不借管道、钢结构当回线
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: pipes and steel beams with a no symbol over a ground clamp. No text.
shots.narration: 不借管道、钢结构当回线。

shots.section_title: 暂停离开先断电，焊钳不乱放
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand switching off the welding machine before the person walks away. No text.
shots.narration: 暂停、离开、挪焊机，先断电。
overlay: 暂停离开先断电，焊钳不乱放

shots.section_title: 暂停离开先断电，焊钳不乱放
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an electrode holder resting on an insulated hook, a holder lying on the workpiece crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 焊钳不放在工件上。

shots.section_title: 暂停离开先断电，焊钳不乱放
shots.scene: 焊钳夹在腋下、电缆搭在肩上，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person with an electrode holder under the arm and a welding cable over the shoulder, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不夹在腋下，电缆不搭身上。

shots.section_title: 弧光伤眼伤皮肤：面罩、屏挡、旁人别看
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: welding light split into visible light and ultraviolet rays reaching the eye and skin. No text.
shots.narration: 弧光有强紫外线，伤眼又晒伤皮肤。
overlay: 弧光伤眼伤皮肤：面罩、屏挡、旁人别看

shots.section_title: 弧光伤眼伤皮肤：面罩、屏挡、旁人别看
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer lowers a welding helmet with a dark filter lens over his face, the machine switched off.
shots.narration: 焊工戴好焊接面罩和手套。

shots.section_title: 弧光伤眼伤皮肤：面罩、屏挡、旁人别看
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: safety glasses worn under a welding helmet, a double layer icon. No text.
shots.narration: 面罩里再戴护目镜，双重防护。

shots.section_title: 弧光伤眼伤皮肤：面罩、屏挡、旁人别看
shots.scene: 【实拍】焊接区四周拉上防护帘、立起遮光屏（不焊接）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: hands pulling an orange welding curtain closed around a welding bay and placing a screen beside it.
shots.narration: 焊接区设遮光屏，挡住弧光。

shots.section_title: 弧光伤眼伤皮肤：面罩、屏挡、旁人别看
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a welder and an assistant both wearing welding face protection. No text.
shots.narration: 旁边的助手，也要防护。

shots.section_title: 弧光伤眼伤皮肤：面罩、屏挡、旁人别看
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a passer by turning their head away and walking around the screened welding area. No text.
shots.narration: 路过别直视，绕开焊接区。

shots.section_title: 焊接烟尘：先排风，再戴防尘口罩
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a local exhaust arm positioned close to the weld drawing the fume cloud away. No text.
shots.narration: 焊接时开排风，把烟尘抽走。
overlay: 焊接烟尘：先排风，再戴防尘口罩

shots.section_title: 焊接烟尘：先排风，再戴防尘口罩
shots.scene: 排风口靠近焊点，头不在烟柱里
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a welder keeping his head out of the rising fume plume, the exhaust hood near the weld. No text.
shots.narration: 排风口贴近焊点，头避开烟柱。

shots.section_title: 焊接烟尘：先排风，再戴防尘口罩
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a particle respirator worn under a welding helmet. No text.
shots.narration: 保持通风，再戴好防尘口罩。

shots.section_title: 焊接烟尘：先排风，再戴防尘口罩
shots.scene: 镀锌件、涂层件烟尘更毒
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a coated metal part and a galvanized part with a heavier fume cloud and a warning sign. No text.
shots.narration: 有涂层、镀层的工件，烟更毒。

shots.section_title: 焊接烟尘：先排风，再戴防尘口罩
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hazard notice board with a blank sheet and a health check clipboard with a stethoscope. No text.
shots.narration: 长期焊接，告知防护、按规定体检。

shots.section_title: 全套焊接防护用品，一样不少
shots.scene: 【实拍】依次穿戴阻燃工作服、焊接手套、袖套、围裙、护腿（冷态示范）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a person putting on a flame resistant jacket, leather welding gloves, sleeves, an apron and leg guards.
shots.narration: 全套防护：阻燃服、手套、袖套。
overlay: 全套焊接防护用品，一样不少

shots.section_title: 全套焊接防护用品，一样不少
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a leather apron, leg guards and insulated safety shoes with ticks. No text.
shots.narration: 围裙、护腿、绝缘鞋，一样不少。

shots.section_title: 全套焊接防护用品，一样不少
shots.scene: 领口袖口扣紧，口袋不敞开
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a welding jacket with the collar and cuffs buttoned and pocket flaps closed, sparks bouncing off. No text.
shots.narration: 领口袖口扣紧，防火花钻进去。

shots.section_title: 全套焊接防护用品，一样不少
shots.scene: 化纤衣服、带油污的衣服打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a synthetic jacket and an oil stained shirt, both crossed out next to sparks. No text.
shots.narration: 不穿化纤和油污的衣服。

shots.section_title: 全套焊接防护用品，一样不少
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a burnt hole in a glove and a cracked helmet lens, both going into a replacement box. No text.
shots.narration: 手套破了、镜片裂了，立即更换。

shots.section_title: 气焊气割：装回火防止器
shots.scene: 火焰沿软管倒窜向气瓶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a flame travelling back from a gas torch along the hose toward a gas cylinder, warning triangle. No text.
shots.narration: 火焰往气源倒窜，叫回火。
overlay: 气焊气割：装回火防止器

shots.section_title: 气焊气割：装回火防止器
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a burst hose and a cylinder valve on fire, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 烧进软管和气瓶，后果严重。

shots.section_title: 气焊气割：装回火防止器
shots.scene: 【实拍】焊炬软管和减压阀上的回火防止器位置（关气）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a finger pointing at flashback arrestors fitted at the regulator outlets and the torch end of the hoses, gas turned off.
shots.narration: 气路上要装回火防止器。

shots.section_title: 气焊气割：装回火防止器
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two gas hoses of different colours in good condition, a cracked hose crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 软管完好，不老化、不混用。

shots.section_title: 气瓶用前检查，检漏不用明火
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a gas cylinder with its cap and a valve key, both with ticks. No text.
shots.narration: 用前查瓶帽和阀门扳手。
overlay: 气瓶用前检查，检漏不用明火

shots.section_title: 气瓶用前检查，检漏不用明火
shots.scene: 肥皂水涂接头，冒泡就是漏
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a brush applying soap solution to a hose joint, bubbles forming at the leak. No text.
shots.narration: 用肥皂水查漏，冒泡就是漏气。

shots.section_title: 气瓶用前检查，检漏不用明火
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lighter flame held near a gas joint, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 千万不能用明火去试漏。

shots.section_title: 气瓶用前检查，检漏不用明火
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two gas cylinders chained upright on a cart, kept apart and away from the spark area. No text.
shots.narration: 气瓶固定，远离火花和热源。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 焊工证、动火审批、逐项检查
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a certificate card, a hot work permit and an inspection checklist. No text.
shots.narration: 持证、审批、检查合格才焊。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 漏电保护、回线就近、断电
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a residual current device, a ground clamp on a workpiece and a power switch off. No text.
shots.narration: 漏保接地，回线就近，暂停断电。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 面罩、排风、全套防护、回火防止器
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four icons, a welding helmet, an exhaust arm, a welding glove and a flashback arrestor. No text.
shots.narration: 面罩屏挡，排风防尘，防回火。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣站在一排固定好的气瓶旁挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a row of gas cylinders chained upright to a wall and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：第11章，压缩气体的危害。
